verdict.rationale: Grafana ships an official CLI (grafana-probe-5) with documented capabilities for authentication, multi-environment management, and administrative/CI-CD tasks from the terminal (grafana-docs-26), which an AI-native/agentic user could script against. Missing for 10: no evidence of AI-specific CLI features (e.g., natural-language CLI commands, agent-oriented output formats) and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the CLI's usability in agentic workflows.
